svg.title: C14 against P15 and against P19, to scale
svg.desc: Left: the AGV on C14 and a tray on P15 overlap. Right: the same AGV and a tray on P19 do not. Same scale, same column of the layout.

g.text: Both rectangles have their long side along the row, so they overlap when the centre-to-centre distance along the column is less than half the sum of their widths. The

g.text: collision table stores the answer of this test for every pair of footprints and poses.
